content: {"episode_id":"ep-05160","cpt":"93247","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the PR-204 denial of CPT 93247, long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring, for episode ep-05160. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent dizziness that have persisted despite initial management for supraventricular tachycardia, supporting diagnosis codes I47.1 and R42. The note states that a long-term continuous ECG monitoring study is indicated to further characterize the arrhythmia and correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances. We request reconsideration of the determination that this service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan and payment of the outstanding balance of 295.03."}
